function myCourseIds(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE+"mycrs")||"[]")}catch(e){return []}}
function myCourseSave(ids){try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE+"mycrs",JSON.stringify(ids))}catch(e){}}
function crsIsOpen(id){return myCourseIds().indexOf(id)>=0}
var CRS={course:null,vids:[],cur:0,player:null,ti:null};
function crsIns(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE+"inst")||"null")}catch(e){return null}}
function crsProg(id){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE+"crs_"+id)||"{}")}catch(e){return{}}}
function crsSaveTick(){
  if(!CRS.course)return;
  var t=0;try{t=CRS.player.getCurrentTime()||0}catch(e){}
  try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE+"crs_"+CRS.course.id,JSON.stringify({v:CRS.cur,t:t}))}catch(e){}
}
function crsLoadYTApi(){
  if(window.YT&&window.YT.Player)return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise(function(res){
    var s=document.createElement("script");s.src="https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
    var t0=Date.now();
    var iv=setInterval(function(){
      if(window.YT&&window.YT.Player){clearInterval(iv);res()}
      else if(Date.now()-t0>9000){clearInterval(iv);res()}
    },150);
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  });
}
async function openInstCourses(){
  var ins=getInst();if(!ins)return;
  var old=document.getElementById("instModalBack");if(old)old.remove();
  var b=document.createElement("div");b.className="modal-back open";b.id="instModalBack";
  b.onclick=function(e){if(e.target===b)b.remove()};
  var m=document.createElement("div");m.className="modal feat-modal";
  m.innerHTML='<h2>🎓 Institute Courses</h2><div class="sub">From '+escH(ins.name)+'</div><div id="crsListBox" class="feat-sec"><small>Loading…</small></div>';
  b.appendChild(m);document.body.appendChild(b);
  try{
    var r=await fetch(SB_URL+"/inst_courses?select=*&inst_code=eq."+encodeURIComponent(ins.code)+"&order=id.desc",{headers:{apikey:SB_KEY,Authorization:"Bearer "+SB_KEY}});
    var rows=await r.json();
    var box=document.getElementById("crsListBox");if(!box)return;
    if(!rows||!rows.length){box.innerHTML='<small>No courses published yet — ask your teacher.</small>';return}
    var hh="";
    rows.forEach(function(c){
      var open=crsIsOpen(c.id);
      hh+='<div class="feat-row" style="cursor:pointer;align-items:center" onclick="'+(open?("instPlay("+c.id+")"):("crsUnlockUI("+c.id+","+(c.price||0)+")"))+'"><div style="flex:1"><b>'+escH(c.title)+'</b><small>'+escH(c.description||"")+(c.price>0?(" · ₹"+c.price):" · FREE")+'</small></div><span class="lib-chip">'+(open?"▶ Watch":"🔒 Unlock")+'</span></div>';
    });
    box.innerHTML=hh;
  }catch(e){var bx=document.getElementById("crsListBox");if(bx)bx.innerHTML='<small>Could not load — check internet</small>'}
}
function crsUnlockUI(id,price){
  var code=(prompt("Enter the course access code your teacher gave you:")||"").trim().toUpperCase();
  if(!code)return;
  crsUnlock(id,price,code);
}
async function crsUnlock(id,price,code){
  toast("Checking code…");
  try{
    var r=await fetch(SB_URL+"/course_codes?select=code,course_id,used&code=eq."+encodeURIComponent(code),{headers:{apikey:SB_KEY,Authorization:"Bearer "+SB_KEY}});
    var rows=await r.json();
    if(!rows||!rows.length){toast("Wrong code — check with your teacher");return}
    var cc=rows[0];
    if(cc.course_id!==id){toast("This code is for a different course");return}
    if(cc.used){toast("This code was already used");return}
    var nm="";try{nm=userName()||"student"}catch(e){nm="student"}
    var r2=await fetch(SB_URL+"/course_codes?code=eq."+encodeURIComponent(code),{method:"PATCH",headers:{apikey:SB_KEY,Authorization:"Bearer "+SB_KEY,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({used:true,used_by:nm,price_at_sale:price})});
    if(!r2.ok){toast("Could not unlock — try again");return}
    var ids=myCourseIds();ids.push(id);myCourseSave(ids);
    toast("🎉 Course unlocked — enjoy!");
    openInstCourses();
  }catch(e){toast("Could not reach the server")}
}
async function instPlay(id){
  var ins=getInst();if(!ins)return;
  var course=null,vids=[];
  try{
    var r=await fetch(SB_URL+"/inst_courses?select=*&id=eq."+id,{headers:{apikey:SB_KEY,Authorization:"Bearer "+SB_KEY}});
    var cr=(await r.json())[0];
    var r2=await fetch(SB_URL+"/course_videos?select=*&course_id=eq."+id+"&order=sort.asc,id.asc",{headers:{apikey:SB_KEY,Authorization:"Bearer "+SB_KEY}});
    vids=await r2.json();
    course=cr;
  }catch(e){toast("Could not load course");return}
  if(!course||!vids||!vids.length){toast("No videos in this course yet");return}
  await crsLoadYTApi();
  if(!(window.YT&&window.YT.Player)){toast("Video player could not load — check internet");return}
  var old=document.getElementById("crsBack");if(old)old.remove();
  var b=document.createElement("div");b.id="crsBack";b.className="crs-back";
  b.innerHTML='<div class="crs-top"><button class="crs-x" title="Close player">✕</button><div class="crs-tt"><b></b><small></small></div></div>'
    +'<div class="crs-stage"><div id="crsPlayer"></div></div>'
    +'<div class="crs-stage-btm"><button class="crs-next">Next video ▶</button><span class="crs-pos"></span></div>'
    +'<div class="crs-listhead">Episodes</div><div class="crs-list"></div>';
  document.body.appendChild(b);
  document.body.style.overflow="hidden";
  b.querySelector(".crs-x").onclick=crsClose;
  b.querySelector(".crs-next").onclick=function(){crsGo(CRS.cur+1)};
  CRS.course=course;CRS.vids=vids;CRS.player=null;
  var st=crsProg(id);
  CRS.cur=(st&&typeof st.v==="number"&&st.v<vids.length)?st.v:0;
  crsHeader();crsRenderList();
  crsMount(vids[CRS.cur].yt,(st&&st.t)||0);
  if(CRS.ti)clearInterval(CRS.ti);
  CRS.ti=setInterval(crsSaveTick,3000);
  b.scrollTop=0;
}
function crsHeader(){
  var b=document.getElementById("crsBack");if(!b)return;
  var tt=b.querySelector(".crs-tt b"),sm=b.querySelector(".crs-tt small");
  if(tt)tt.textContent=CRS.course.title||"Course";
  if(sm)sm.textContent=(CRS.cur+1)+" of "+CRS.vids.length+" · "+(CRS.vids[CRS.cur].title||"");
}
function crsRenderList(){
  var b=document.getElementById("crsBack");if(!b)return;
  var w=b.querySelector(".crs-list");if(!w)return;
  var hh="";
  CRS.vids.forEach(function(v,i){
    hh+='<div class="crs-ep'+(i===CRS.cur?" on":"")+'" data-i="'+i+'"><span class="crs-ep-n">'+(i+1)+'</span><span class="crs-ep-t">'+escH(v.title||("Video "+(i+1)))+'</span><span class="crs-ep-b">'+(i===CRS.cur?"▶":"")+'</span></div>';
  });
  w.innerHTML=hh;
  w.querySelectorAll(".crs-ep").forEach(function(el){
    el.onclick=function(){crsGo(parseInt(el.getAttribute("data-i"),10))};
  });
  var pos=b.querySelector(".crs-pos");
  if(pos)pos.textContent="";
}
function crsGo(i){
  if(i<0||i>=CRS.vids.length){if(i>=CRS.vids.length)toast("Course complete! 🎉");return}
  CRS.cur=i;
  crsHeader();crsRenderList();crsMount(CRS.vids[i].yt,0);
  var b=document.getElementById("crsBack");if(b)b.scrollTop=0;
}
function crsMount(vidId,startSec){
  if(CRS.player){
    try{CRS.player.loadVideoById({videoId:vidId,startSeconds:Math.floor(startSec||0)});return}catch(e){CRS.player=null}
  }
  CRS.player=new YT.Player("crsPlayer",{
    videoId:vidId,
    playerVars:{autoplay:1,rel:0,modestbranding:1,playsinline:1,iv_load_policy:3,start:Math.floor(startSec||0)},
    events:{
      onReady:function(e){try{if(startSec&&startSec>3)e.target.seekTo(startSec,true);e.target.playVideo()}catch(x){}},
      onStateChange:function(e){if(window.YT&&e.data===YT.PlayerState.ENDED)crsGo(CRS.cur+1)}
    }
  });
}
function crsClose(){
  try{if(CRS.player)CRS.player.destroy()}catch(e){}
  CRS.player=null;
  if(CRS.ti){clearInterval(CRS.ti);CRS.ti=null}
  crsSaveTick();
  var b=document.getElementById("crsBack");if(b)b.remove();
  document.body.style.overflow="";
}
(function(){
  var st=document.createElement("style");
  st.textContent=".crs-back{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:#05070a;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}"
   +".crs-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b0e13,#05070a);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2}"
   +".crs-x{background:none;border:1px solid #2a3342;color:#e8ecf3;border-radius:9px;width:34px;height:34px;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}"
   +".crs-tt{min-width:0}.crs-tt b{font-size:15px;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.crs-tt small{color:#8b95a7;font-size:11.5px}"
   +".crs-stage{width:100%;max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 12px 0;background:#000}"
   +"#crsPlayer{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#000}"
   +".crs-back iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block}"
   +".crs-stage-btm{width:100%;max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#05070a;position:relative}"
   +".crs-next{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d4af37,#f5d97a);color:#1a1405;border:none;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 16px;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;cursor:pointer}"
   +".crs-pos{color:#8b95a7;font-size:12px}"
   +".crs-listhead{width:100%;max-width:920px;margin:4px auto 0;padding:10px 14px 4px;color:#8b95a7;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase}"
   +".crs-list{width:100%;max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 12px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}"
   +".crs-ep{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#141922;border:1px solid #232b38;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 13px;cursor:pointer}"
   +".crs-ep.on{border-color:#d4af37;background:#1a1b16}"
   +".crs-ep-n{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;background:#1d2430;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;color:#d4af37;flex-shrink:0}"
   +".crs-ep-t{flex:1;font-size:14px;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}"
   +".crs-ep-b{color:#d4af37;font-size:12px;width:18px;text-align:center}";
  document.head.appendChild(st);
})();
